Hello, I want to explain properly what happened with the electric standing desk from ORD-10302, because I think the details matter. The desk was delivered on time and the courier was friendly, so no complaint there. I unpacked it the same evening and followed the assembly guide step by step. The frame went together fine, the crossbar lined up, and the desktop screwed on without any trouble. The problem started when I plugged it in. The control panel lit up, but when I pressed the up button the left leg rose and the right leg did not move at all, so the desktop tilted badly and a coffee mug slid off. I stopped straight away. I tried the reset procedure from the manual: holding the down button for ten seconds until it beeped, then trying again. The same thing happened. I then checked every cable. The motor cable on the right leg is fine at the control box end, but where it goes into the leg the plastic housing is cracked right through, and you can see that the connector inside is bent. It looks like it was crushed in transit, because the box had a large dent on that corner, which I photographed before I opened it. I did not force anything and I did not use any tools on the motor. I have attached nothing yet because I was not sure where to send the photos, but I have them and I am happy to share them. I work from the co-working space three days a week and at home the other two, and I bought this desk so I could stand for part of the day for my back, so at the moment it is unusable and I am back at my kitchen table. I would rather not keep a desk that tilts, because it is not safe with a monitor on it. I would like a refund for the desk please. I still have all the packaging, the manual, the remote and every screw, and I can take it apart again and have it ready for collection whenever suits your courier. Please let me know what you need from me. Thank you for your help, and sorry for the long message; I wanted to give you the whole picture in one go so you do not have to ask me lots of questions.
